capabilities: Insert Markdown formatting, links, callouts and Mermaid diagrams from toolbar buttons
Edit Markdown tables (insert, sort, transpose, paste as table, copy as TSV/CSV/JSON)
Pick emoji, kaomoji and symbols from a bundled offline panel
Pin commands from core or other plugins in a custom tab
Run line, list and clean-up utilities and view/focus modes
disambiguation: Not a WYSIWYG editor; it overlays buttons on Obsidian's plain-Markdown editor and writes standard Markdown or small inline HTML.
extras: Works on Desktop and Mobile with separate position toggles; explicitly no AI, network calls, accounts or telemetry; can be used as a keyboard-only command pack with all four toolbar positions off; ships with localization in eight languages.
motivation: The author built it to remove the Markdown syntax wall for non-technical users while keeping the vault 100% plain text.
problem: Obsidian's Markdown syntax is a barrier for users who don't already speak it, such as students or writers coming from Word or Google Docs.
summary: Word-style Markdown formatting toolbar with 202 one-click commands, a table editor, an offline emoji picker, and four independently toggleable toolbar positions.
